title: Japanese Researchers Develop Wearable Robot Arms (2/2)
titleZh: 日本研究人員開發穿戴式機器手臂 (2/2)
summaryZh: 介紹日本研發的穿戴式機器手臂，以及它未來可能的各種用途。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Health & Lifestyle

sentences.text: The dancers come together and move in similar ways, either leading or following the robot arms.
sentences.zh: 舞者聚在一起，用相似的方式移動，有時帶領機器手臂，有時跟著手臂動。

sentences.text: Inami said, "Some wearers grow attached to the arms after some time.
sentences.zh: 稻見說：「有些使用者戴久了會對這些手臂產生感情。

sentences.text: Taking them off after using them for a while feels a little sad.
sentences.zh: 用了一陣子之後再把它們拆下來，會覺得有點捨不得。

sentences.text: That's where they're a little different to other tools," he said.
sentences.zh: 他說，這就是它們跟其他工具有點不一樣的地方。」

sentences.text: But Inami added that the possibilities for the robot arms go beyond turning a short story into real life.
sentences.zh: 不過稻見補充說，這種機器手臂的可能性不只是把小說情節變成現實。

sentences.text: He said such machines could help in search and rescue operations.
sentences.zh: 他說這類機器可以用來協助搜救工作。

sentences.text: He wondered if similar devices could be used to fly or perform sports in the future.
sentences.zh: 他好奇未來類似的裝置能不能拿來飛行，或是用來做運動。

sentences.text: In the future, we might see wings growing out of people's backs or drones attached to people.
sentences.zh: 未來我們可能會看到人的背上長出翅膀，或是身上裝著無人機。

sentences.text: Maybe someone will come up with a sport that requires six arms.
sentences.zh: 說不定有人會想出一種需要六隻手臂的運動。

sentences.text: Or invent a new type of swimming," Inami said.
sentences.zh: 稻見說：「或是發明一種新的游泳方式。」
